text:
alex: Heads up — starting cutover to `metrics_horizon` tomorrow 04:00 UTC. Need final checks for dashboards, quota calcs, and ingest read adapters. Shadow writes are done. Read-adapter toggle ready. Who's oncall?
jess: Oncall is @sam, I can cover until ~06:00 UTC. Which dashboards do we expect to break?
alex: Quick list: Console -> Billing Overview, Route Quota heatmap, Per-route latency p99s. Also any custom org dashboards that query `metrics_agg` directly. Link to runbook: https://wiki/redwood/runbooks/metrics-horizon (dev note).
sam: Plan for cutover? Canary traffic %, timing, validation steps?
alex: Canary plan: 5% for 15m -> 25% for 30m -> 100% if green. Validation: parity check job + quick spot-check dashboards. Parity job writes a report to s3 and posts to #eng-platform.
rachel: Quota calc change: `metrics_horizon` adds `horizon_window` which changes how we do sliding-window quotas. Need to update console quota-service and alert thresholds. Will need a migration flag in console to switch algorithms.
matt: Backfill note: full backfill will run ~18h on prod cluster if we do naive `INSERT SELECT`. Recommend incremental backfill by day to avoid long locks.
alex: Agreed. Proposed backfill snippet (runs per-day):
```sql
INSERT INTO metrics_horizon (route_id, ts, value, horizon_window)
SELECT route_id, ts, value, compute_horizon(ts) FROM metrics_legacy WHERE ts >= $DAY_START AND ts < $DAY_END;
```
We'll queue per-day jobs with max concurrency 6.
ingest-bot: shadow-write status: 99.71% success over last 24h, tail latency p95 18ms. No schema errors reported.
jess: Parity tests — what does the report include? I want token counts, p50/p95 latencies, row counts by route. Also diffs for alerting queries.
alex: Parity report fields: `route_id`, `metric_name`, `legacy_count`, `horizon_count`, `count_diff_pct`, `p50_legacy`, `p50_horizon`. If `count_diff_pct` > 0.5% for any top-100 routes we abort cutoff.
sam: For read-adapter toggle: make sure can route by header `X-METRICS-READ=legacy|horizon`. We'll slowly flip at router layer. Fallback: `curl -X POST https://control-plane/flags/metrics_read -d '{"value":"legacy"}'` to rollback.
rachel: Alerts — update rule for quota burn rate, sample alert snippet:
```yaml
alert: quota-burn-rate-high
expr: increase(horizon.quota_used[5m]) / increase(horizon.quota_alloc[5m]) > 0.8
for: 10m
```
We'll keep old alert rules until parity + 24h.
matt: One more: Grafana templated panels that reference `metrics_agg` by table name will need to be switched to the new view. I'll prep a dashboard migration job that patches queries for known panels.
jess: Who owns the dashboard patch run? @matt? If you need a quick script I can help.
matt: I got it — will run a dry-run against staging dashboards this afternoon.
ingest-bot: Canary parity job started for 5% window @3580010000, ETA 12m.
alex: final checklist for tomorrow: 1) backfill day-0 done, 2) canary 5% + parity green, 3) update quota-service flag, 4) patch dashboards, 5) promote to 25%. If any step fails we rollback read-adapter flag and pause backfill.
sam: I'll be oncall. Set me in pagerduty for 03:30–07:30 UTC.
jess: noted. Posting runbook link in #oncall. :thumbsup:
alex: thanks team — will post updates during cutover in this thread and #release-war-room. Ping me if you see >0.5% diff on parity.
rachel: adding a pre-cutover smoke: run the `quota_calc` tests against horizon on staging (10m) before flip.
matt: ack. dry-run dashboards done by 02:00 UTC.
ingest-bot: parity job complete: 5% window, all checks passed, max count_diff_pct = 0.12% (top routes).
all: :party_parrot:
